Term Detail

Prep Cook

GENERAL • Platform/tooling support
Back
Tech Equivalents
Restaurant Definition
In a professional kitchen, 'Prep Cook' represents a specific operational concept tied to roles & structure. It reflects how teams coordinate work, manage resources, and maintain flow under real-time pressure. In technology environments, this maps to 'Platform/tooling support', highlighting similar principles of system reliability, workflow coordination, and performance optimization. Understanding this concept helps teams design processes that are resilient, efficient, and scalable.
  • Kitchen: The team ensures 'Prep Cook' is completed before service begins.
  • Tech Ops: Engineers confirm platform/tooling support is complete before deployment.
  • Failure Scenario: When 'Prep Cook' is skipped, delays and errors cascade.
  • Scaling Scenario: Strong platform/tooling support practices allow systems to scale smoothly.
Tech Definition
Platform/tooling support
  • Think of 'Prep Cook' like platform/tooling support in a distributed system — if it isn’t done correctly
  • downstream services fail
  • latency increases
  • and recovery becomes expensive.
